title: PROTEIN
style: warm documentary photography, a white kitchen counter by a large window, morning sunlight falling across the worktop, bright and airy, natural textures, shallow depth of field, high detail

music.tags: driving montage rock, muted electric guitar ostinato, four on the floor kick, snare build, hand claps, determined, instrumental

beats.prompt: Eggs, chicken, lentils and yoghurt arranged on a wooden board, top-down, natural light, documentary style
beats.motion: Light moves slowly across the board.
beats.caption: Most people get this slightly wrong

line.text: Protein is the one most people already understand and still get slightly wrong.

beats.prompt: A kitchen scale with a portion of food on it, close-up, morning light, shallow focus
beats.caption: The daily total matters most

line.text: The research points at a daily total, spread across the day - not a magic window right after training.

beats.prompt: A protein shaker on a gym bench in warm side light, condensation on the surface, close-up
beats.motion: A drop of condensation runs down the side.
beats.caption: Powder is convenience, not magic

line.text: Powder is a convenience, not a category of its own. It is food that happens to be easy to carry.

beats.sfx: a shaker set down on a bench

beats.prompt: A simple home-cooked meal on a plate, warm evening light, honest and ordinary, documentary style
beats.caption: Needs go up - not that far up

line.text: Needs go up if you are training hard or older. They do not go up to the numbers on the tub.

beats.prompt: An empty clean plate on a wooden table, soft light, minimal
beats.caption: Not medical advice

line.text: General information, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about what fits you.
